t: Titan TTB1337ROU 1200W electric router delivers precise cutting and shaping for woodworking projects. The corded tool is designed for joiners and kitchen fitters routing grooves, rebates, and decorative edges. Micro depth adjustment and 4 preset depth stops enable fast, repeatable cuts, while the parallel guide ensures straight, accurate runs. Variable speed control from 11 to 30,000rpm allows the speed to be matched to the material. Includes spindle lock to simplify bit changes, and vacuum adaptor to connect to dust extraction systems for a cleaner workspace.
